description: **Core mechanic** : Terra fills her own graveyard (Trance: mill 2 + flying at combat) then reanimates threats for free.
**Engine** : Celes, Stitcher's Supplier and Priest of Fell Rites mill; Reanimate and Karmic Guide bring back the board.
**Payoff** : free reanimation of big threats every turn.
**Core mechanic** : graveyard value — mill, reanimation and flashback.
**Core mechanic** : self-mill to fuel reanimation and Terra's Trance.
**Engine** : Stitcher's Supplier, Celes and mill spells.
win: **Mass reanimate** : Karmic Guide / Priest of Fell Rites.

description: **Core mechanic** : aggressive reanimation — Trance flying + reanimated threats.
**Core mechanic** : mill the table while filling your own yard.
**Payoff** : opponents deck out while you reanimate.

text: **Reanimator (1,996) is the clear favorite**: 9 of the deck's 92 cards sit in its EDHREC High Synergy pool (Celes, Rune Knight, Reanimate, Priest of Fell Rites, Anger, Stitch Together, Stitcher's Supplier, Meteor Golem, Locke, Siegfried) — the plan the precon was built for.
**Self-Mill (567) and Mill (331) are co-second**: 10/10 pool overlap each — the deck's mill package (Millikin, Stitcher's Supplier, Laughing Mad, Rise of the Dark Realms) feeds the yard directly.
**Aggro (348) is incidental**: 7/10 overlap via the haste package (Anger) and the evasive attackers — the deck attacks because it reanimates, not the reverse.

**Structural gaps**: only 6 interaction slots (under the 10-12 ideal) and 1 wipe (Ruinous Ultimatum) — the deck is a race to its reanimation targets, vulnerable to graveyard hate (a single Bojuka Bog-style answer hurts).
**Speed concern**: average nonland CMC 3.74 (ideal ≤ 3.2) with 14 ramp slots — the curve is heavy but the ramp mostly compensates; expect the deck to be strong turns 5-7, weaker before.
